decisions.reason: The award, the dedicated product page, and the firm’s recent public investment make management very likely to continue backing this geothermal probe rather than reverse course so soon.

Although there is no visible performance evidence after launch, the recent launch, dedicated presentation, and likely shared development with the geothermal line encourage management to stay committed and blame weak traction on market ramp-up.
As a complementary surface technology tied to the geothermal probe strategy, it benefits from sunk development costs and public commitment, even if its standalone results remain unclear.

A fire-protection steel profile system is close to the firm’s core basic-metals and profile business, so management is inclined to retain it and justify the launch through a longer commercialization horizon.
Because a slim steel profile system fits the established steel-products portfolio and required visible launch effort, management is likely to persist rather than admit the investment was premature.

Even without reported results, this decorative steel profile surface system remains close enough to the firm’s core capabilities that management would usually continue it and attribute any weak uptake to temporary market conditions.
